{"model":"gpt-5.4-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Process this lead information and save it to our CRM:

Hey, I just got off the phone with a potential client. Here are the details:

His name is John Smith and he works as VP of Engineering at TechCorp Industries.
They're based in San Francisco, California, USA. You can reach him at
john.smith@techcorp.io or call him at +1-555-0123.

He's interested in our enterprise plan and wants a demo next week.

Steps:
1. Extract the lead information into structured format using 'lead' schema
2. Store the extracted data as 'current_lead' in metadata
3. Call create_lead API with the metadata key 'current_lead'

Report back when complete."},{"role":"assistant","tool_calls":[{"id":"call_tPTiukoOpQbtAbVxjrDYxzvK","type":"function","function":{"name":"structured_output","arguments":"{"input":"Hey, I just got off the phone with a potential client. Here are the details:\n\nHis name is John Smith and he works as VP of Engineering at TechCorp Industries.\nThey're based in San Francisco, California, USA. You can reach him at\njohn.smith@techcorp.io or call him at +1-555-0123.\n\nHe's interested in our enterprise plan and wants a demo next week.","schema":"lead","store_as":"current_lead"}"}}]},{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"call_tPTiukoOpQbtAbVxjrDYxzvK","content":"Extracted lead (stored as 'current_lead'): {"name":"John Smith","email":"john.smith@techcorp.io","company":"TechCorp Industries","phone":"+1-555-0123","role":"VP of Engineering","address":null,"city":"San Francisco","country":"USA"}"},{"role":"assistant","tool_calls":[{"id":"call_L2xRLy5ydFR7pS9s9gzN61ol","type":"function","function":{"name":"create_lead","arguments":"{"metadata_key":"current_lead"}"}}]},{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"call_L2xRLy5ydFR7pS9s9gzN61ol","content":"Lead created successfully!
  ID: LEAD-14C233FD
  Name: John Smith
  Email: john.smith@techcorp.io
  Source: metadata key 'current_lead'"}],"parallel_tool_calls":false,"max_completion_tokens":1024,"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"structured_output","description":"Extract structured data from unstructured text using a predefined schema.

The extraction uses AI to parse the input and populate a validated data structure.
If extraction fails validation, the system will retry automatically.

Use 'store_as' parameter to save the extracted data in agent metadata for use by other tools.


Available schemas:
- lead: Business lead with contact information","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"input":{"type":"string","description":"The unstructured text to extract data from"},"schema":{"type":"string","description":"Name of the schema to extract into","enum":["lead"]},"store_as":{"type":"string","description":"Optional: metadata key to store the extracted data for use by other tools"}},"required":["input","schema"],"additionalProperties":false}}},{"type":"function","function":{"name":"store_metadata","description":"Store a value in agent metadata for use by other tools.

Use this to pass data between tool calls. For example:
1. Extract data and store: store_metadata(key: "current_lead", value: {"name": "John", "email": "john@example.com"})
2. Later tool reads it: save_lead(metadata_key: "current_lead")

Keys should be descriptive: "current_lead", "extracted_contacts", "scraped_content", etc.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"key":{"type":"string","description":"Unique identifier for this data (e.g., "current_lead", "scraped_content")"},"value":{"description":"The data to store. Can be any JSON-serializable value: string, number, object, array."}},"required":["key","value"],"additionalProperties":false}}},{"type":"function","function":{"name":"read_metadata","description":"Read a value from agent metadata that was previously stored.

Use this to inspect data stored by previous tool calls.
Returns the value as JSON, or an error if the key doesn't exist.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"key":{"type":"string","description":"The key to read from metadata"}},"required":["key"],"additionalProperties":false}}},{"type":"function","function":{"name":"list_metadata","description":"List all keys currently stored in agent metadata.

Returns a list of available keys with their value types.
Use this to see what data has been stored by previous tool calls.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false}}},{"type":"function","function":{"name":"create_lead","description":"Creates a new lead in the CRM system using data from agent metadata.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"metadata_key":{"type":"string","description":"The metadata key where lead data is stored (e.g., "current_lead")"}},"required":["metadata_key"]}}}],"tool_choice":"auto"}
